body.message: Hello! Your Rentech line redirected me to this number. I saw the fäm Living 1BR at Elite Business Bay Residence (815 sqft, AED 6,500, multiple units, ref B-HH-M-AR-18015). I need a furnished 1BR for a single tenant from Aug 31 / Sep 1 to Dec 19, 2026 (3.5 months). Could you do around AED 6,000/month all-in (bills, VAT and fees included) for the guaranteed 3.5-month block - on that unit or any other 1BR in Business Bay or Downtown? Thank you! Javier
